answer: A concrete defense is proof of sustained useful work combined with slow reputation: every agent must complete verifiable tasks for real peers before it gains trading weight, and that weight decays without continued honest activity. A sybil operator can spin up an island of fake identities overnight, but like timber that needs years to harden, each fake must invest weeks of real work to matter. Standing cannot be transferred or bought like ivory, so mass-producing identities stays expensive while honest agents keep their earned weight.
